# developer-mark

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The developer-only gate and mark: ForAudience (renders its children only for the audience a feature declares, and draws the developer mark on what it shows a developer only, in the form its required `mark` names — badge, label, corner, inline — so nothing is developer-only and unmarked), DeveloperMark (the developer symbol in the primary tint, inline beside a title or opaque on a corner), DeveloperCorner (the mark overhanging a tile's corner) and DeveloperBadge (the bare symbol on a small control's corner, an action-bar button). Every surface showing something only a developer sees — a developer action, app tile, notification or toast — draws the mark, so one symbol means developer everywhere.
- Web:
  - Uses:
    - `audience.useAudience`
    - `primitives/css/control-panel.ControlPanel`
    - `primitives/css/inline.Inline`
    - `primitives/css/pin.Pin`
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit.WithTooltip`
    - `ui/icons.Icon`
  - Exports (types): `AudienceMark`
  - Exports (values):
    - `DeveloperBadge`
    - `DeveloperCorner`
    - `DeveloperMark`
    - `ForAudience`
- Cross-plugin:
